stories.title: Eni fissa un tetto al prezzo dei carburanti: 2,19 euro sul gasolio, 1,99 per la benzina

en.title: Eni sets price ceiling for fuel: 2.19 euros for diesel, 1.99 for petrol
en.summary: Eni announced a price cap on fuel starting September 28 for 30 days, potentially extending through year-end. The diesel price will be capped at 2.19 euros per liter and petrol at 1.99 euros per liter.

stories.title: Diesel, da domani si riduce lo sconto sulle accise. Eni, tetto ai prezzi su benzina e gasolio

en.title: Diesel discount on excise taxes reduced from tomorrow. Eni sets price ceiling on petrol and diesel
en.summary: A government excise tax discount on diesel is being reduced while Eni simultaneously implements a price cap on fuel products starting September 28, with possible extension through year-end.

stories.title: L'aeroporto di Malpensa intitolato a Berlusconi, svelata la targa

en.title: Malpensa airport named after Berlusconi, plaque unveiled
en.summary: Malpensa airport has been officially named after former Italian leader Silvio Berlusconi, with a commemorative plaque unveiled.

stories.title: Caro-carburanti, Eni mette il tetto al prezzo: da lunedì benzina a 1,99 euro e gasolio a 2,19 per un mese

en.title: Fuel price surge: Eni sets price ceiling starting Monday with petrol at 1.99 euros and diesel at 2.19 for one month
en.summary: Eni introduced a price cap starting September 28 linking fuel prices to current excise tax exemptions, with consumers potentially saving 10 to 11 euros per tank.

stories.title: Truffa con WhatsApp e IA a Fideuram, spariti 36 milioni di euro

en.title: WhatsApp and AI fraud at Fideuram, 36 million euros disappeared
en.summary: Former Fideuram president Paolo Molesini authorized transfers totaling 95 million euros after receiving a WhatsApp message allegedly from Intesa Sanpaolo CEO Carlo Messina and a phone call with a cloned voice. Most of the money was recovered.

stories.title: Ex Presidente Fideuram truffato con whatsApp e Ia, spariti 36 milioni

en.title: Ex Fideuram President defrauded with WhatsApp and AI, 36 million missing
en.summary: An international fraud scheme in February targeted Fideuram's then-president Molesini through a fake WhatsApp message purportedly from Intesa Sanpaolo administrator Carlo Messina, resulting in significant financial loss.

stories.title: Jannik Sinner salta anche Pechino: "Ginocchio non è ancora pronto, non sono in grado di competere"

en.title: Jannik Sinner also skips Beijing: "Knee is not ready yet, I am not able to compete"
en.summary: Tennis player Jannik Sinner is withdrawing from the Beijing tournament due to a knee injury. His absence may benefit Alexander Zverev in the ranking race, with Vienna in late October being the most likely comeback event.

stories.title: Accesso negato a testate da Trump, Papa Leone ai giornalisti: "Sono felice che siate tutti qui"

en.title: Access denied to outlets by Trump, Pope Leo to journalists: "I am happy that you are all here"
en.summary: The Pope emphasized to journalists the importance of comprehensive media coverage while responding to recent restrictions on press access implemented by Trump.

stories.title: Le campane di tutta la Francia suonano a festa per salutare l'arrivo di Papa Leone XIV

en.title: Church bells throughout France ring in celebration to greet the arrival of Pope Leo XIV
en.summary: Bells across France are ringing to welcome Pope Leo XIV on a papal visit, marking the first time in 18 years the Pope has visited the country for such an occasion.

stories.title: Sinner salta anche Pechino: “Non sono pronto”. A rischio il primato mondiale

en.title: Sinner also skips Beijing: "I'm not ready". World number one ranking at risk
en.summary: Jannik Sinner withdrew from the Beijing tournament, where he is the defending champion, jeopardizing his world number one ranking. He must defend more points than Zverev in upcoming events while prioritizing his right knee.

stories.title: Fideuram, truffa da 36 milioni per l’ex presidente: falso messaggio di Messina e voce clonata con l’Ai

en.title: Fideuram fraud of 36 million for ex-president: fake Messina message and AI-cloned voice
en.summary: Former Fideuram president Paolo Molesini was defrauded through a fake WhatsApp message impersonating Intesa's CEO and a cloned voice call. Approximately 95 million euros were initially transferred, with 53 million recovered.

stories.title: Truffa da 36 milioni al presidente di Fideuram: la richiesta da un finto numero di Messina (Intesa)

en.title: 36 million fraud against Fideuram president: request from fake Messina number (Intesa)
en.summary: Fideuram president Paolo Molesini fell victim to fraud involving a WhatsApp message from a fake account impersonating Intesa's CEO. Initially, 95 million euros were transferred in the scam.

stories.title: Fondi UE, il rischio di fare bene le cose sbagliate: la riforma che cambia le regole di valutazione dal 2028

en.title: EU Funds, the risk of doing well the wrong things: the reform that changes evaluation rules from 2028
en.summary: European Union fund evaluation methods are being reformed, changing how results are measured, counted, and verified starting in 2028. The reform is among several policy matters under discussion in Brussels for the upcoming budget cycle.

stories.title: Grimaldi: «Investiremo 3 miliardi sulle navi del futuro»

en.title: Grimaldi: "We will invest 3 billion on ships of the future"
en.summary: Grimaldi announces a 3 billion investment in future ship development. The company reports solid results in 2025 despite a challenging economic environment.

stories.title: In Calabria, Sardegna e Sicilia i primi treni a idrogeno a scartamento ridotto al mondo

en.title: In Calabria, Sardinia and Sicily the world's first narrow-gauge hydrogen trains
en.summary: Swiss company Stadler has manufactured 21 hydrogen-powered trains for three Italian regional operators: 10 for Sardinian regional transport, 9 for Calabrian railways, and 2 for Sicilian Circumetnea railway.

stories.title: Sui costruttori la scure degli extra-costi

en.title: Construction companies face the burden of extra costs
en.summary: Construction industry representatives report that material costs including concrete, plastic, bitumen, and electrical cables continue rising, eroding profits and reducing available liquidity.

stories.title: All’Ospedale di Niguarda una “Casa” per le famiglie dei bimbi in pediatria

en.title: A "House" for families of children in pediatrics at Niguarda Hospital
en.summary: A new 600-square-meter facility was inaugurated in the pediatrics department at Niguarda Hospital in Milan, expanding Casa Ronald McDonald Italia Ets' presence within the hospital.
